title: Jump Game VII
summary: Given a binary string s and integers minJump and maxJump, determine if you can reach the end of the string from index 0 by moving to indices where the value is '0' and within the specified jump range.
statement: Given a binary string s and integers minJump and maxJump, determine if you can reach the end of the string from index 0 by moving to indices where the value is '0' and within the specified jump range.
constraints: A destination is usable only when its character is '0'.
hints: For index i, only reachable indices in [i-max_jump, i-min_jump] can lead to it.
Maintain the number of reachable indices in that interval as a sliding window.
Add the new left candidate, remove the expired candidate, and mark i only when it is zero and the count is positive.
The maintained count exactly represents all valid predecessors, so induction over indices proves every reachability value.

tests.explanation: Reach indices 0, 3, and 5 using jumps of three and two.
Every route becomes blocked before the final position.
